24.content:
# claude.md - Delta Post Accident (tree 683028422)

Unlinked memory node. Read FIRST before editing this tree; update it every edit session.
Quest Diagnostics / Delta Air Lines post-accident + reasonable-suspicion drug & alcohol
testing determination.

## PII / PHI + COMPLIANCE NOTICE
This tree captures drug/alcohol testing determinations, employee roles, injury/medical
status, OSM member ID, internal notes, and contact name/phone; it stages sf_*__c fields
that feed Salesforce and sends TWO automatic external notification emails
(email_send_now="1", no confirmation step) on every session that reaches node 20. This is
PII/PHI and DOT-compliance sensitive. Any LIVE publish/import must be reviewed by a
teammate per Zingtree policy before it ships. Do not push to the live tree from an
automated build.

## Purpose
Agent-facing decision flow that classifies a Delta incident (DOT / Non-DOT / Reasonable
Suspicion / No-Testing), computes the testing determination + sample-collection routing
(airport/base-specific rules, provider sequencing), stages a Salesforce payload, and sends
the internal summary + OSM notification emails.

## Architecture / node map (story order)
- 1  Content  Incident Classification - DOT Check (3 major-accident radios). ROOT. -> 2
- 2  Content  Employee, Airport & Notes -- captures sf_Employee_Name__c (new, CR-005),
              employee_role, sf_Airport_Code__c, sf_Member_ID_Number__c,
              sf_Internal_Notes__c ONCE, upstream of every branch (CR-001 R11/R14/A1).
              Every path below inherits these answers before any determination or
              payload is built. -> 28 (was -> 3 until CR-006, 2026-10-15)
- 28 Content  Event Information & Collection Details (CR-006, 2026-10-15) -- Event
              Address/City/State/Zip, Number of Donors, Location Collector Reports to in
              Airport, Secondary Contact Name/Phone/Email, Date of Collection, Station,
              Flight #, Ship #, Vehicle #. All optional, all predefined so they write back
              to SF. Quest removed these as SF creation requirements. -> 29
              EXCEPT Date of Collection + Number of Donors: captured as date_of_collection /
              number_of_donors (NOT sf_-prefixed) -- see 29-33 (CR-007).
- 29 Script   Stage Typed SF Fields -- date -> YYYY-MM-DD (date_of_collection_iso),
              donors -> digits, flags has_collection_date / has_donor_count. -> 30
- 30 Scoring  has_collection_date == true -> 31 | 32
- 31 Data     Connected Object 503 (update_sf_event_typed, cx_actions/UAT sandbox): UPDATE
              ES_Event_Request__c Id=${sf_Id}, Date_of_Collection__c=${date_of_collection_iso} -> 32
- 32 Scoring  has_donor_count == true -> 33 | 3
- 33 Data     Connected Object 504 (update_sf_event_donors): Number_of_Donors__c=${number_of_donors} -> 3
- 3  Scoring  DOT vs Non-DOT Routing (advanced logic, raw form-field expression --
              pre-existing, unaffected by CR-001) -> 4 (any node-1 answer Yes) | 5 (else)
- 4  Content  DOT Incident - Stop and Call Delta (sets is_manual_dot="true") -> 19
- 5  Scoring  Is Suspicion? (sf_Event_Type == "Suspicion") -> 6 (suspicion) | 10 (else)
- 6  Content  Suspicion Reasoning -- "Are There Signs or Symptoms?"
              (sf_Are_there_any_Signs_or_Symptoms__c, Yes/No) + "What Happened?"
              (sf_Additional_Notes__c, required). -> 26
- 26 Scoring  Signs or Symptoms? (op router) -> 27 (Yes) | 7 (else)
- 27 Content  Signs & Symptoms Observed -- ONE select, sf_Signs_Symptoms__c, repeat_form=12
              ("+" adds another; Zingtree stores sf_Signs_Symptoms__c_1..n). -> 7
- 7  Script   Reasonable Suspicion Testing Determination -- suspicion classification
              PRODUCER. No signs -> RS_NO_TESTING (Testing Not Needed). Yes -> WFH hotline /
              DOT hotline / NON-DOT two-manager checklist by role. Joins
              sf_Signs_Symptoms__c_1..n into sf_Signs_Symptoms__c (";"-separated). -> 8
- 8  Scoring  Is DOT Employee? (op-based router) -> 19 (sf_Are_there_any_Signs_or_Symptoms__c
              == No, first) | 19 (employee_role Other) | 9 (Work From Home Employee) |
              25 (else -- DOT role, via dedicated
              Reasonable-Suspicion DOT alert -- was routed to node 4 until 2026-08-27)
- 9  Content  Work From Home Suspicion (hotline alert) -> 19
- 25 Content  Reasonable Suspicion - DOT Role: Testing Required (dedicated DOT-role
              suspicion alert; added 2026-08-27 so DOT-role suspicion cases no longer
              see node 4's accident-specific "major accident criteria was answered Yes"
              copy) -> 19
- 10 Content  No-Testing Factor Assessment (over-32h, weather, minor, fault,
              hours_elapsed conditional on >32h=="No" -- CR-001 R15 PRESERVED) -> 11
- 11 Scoring  No-Testing Factor Routing (advanced logic, all 4 exemptions met) -> 12 | 13
- 12 Content  No Testing Required (sf_Additional_Notes__c narrative only;
              sf_Member_ID_Number__c REMOVED here -- dup of node 2, CR-001 R14) -> 19
- 13 Content  Select Damage Type (repeatable damage_type radio) -> 14
- 14 Script   Iterate Damage Type Selections (cursor loop) -> 15
- 15 Content  Assessment per Damage Type (per-type conditional fields + notes + fault) -> 16
- 16 Script   Store Selections (push record to transforms.final_records) -> 17
- 17 Scoring  Is More Damage Types? -> 14 (loop) | 18
- 18 Script   Testing Determination Routing -- accident/damage classification PRODUCER
              (no-testing exemptions, medical-care deferral, drug-only 8-32h window,
              per-damage-type qualification). Untouched by CR-001; feeds the shared engine.
              -> 19
- 19 Script   Finalize Determination & Stage SF Payload -- THE UNIFIED ENGINE (CR-001 R12).
              Replaces old nodes 32 + 51. Normalizes employee_role/airport, computes the
              canonical DOT/account-number rule (CR-001 R13), runs the shared airport-
              routing tables, builds final_print_summary_html/_text + the SF payload.
              CR-005 (2026-09-03): also (a) branches the NON-DOT card/copy on whether
              transforms.testing_classification is suspicion-sourced (RS_ prefix, from
              node 7) so accident cases no longer show Reasonable-Suspicion-checklist
              language; (b) renders the aggregated sf_Additional_Notes__c narrative as
              a "What Happened / Notes (Send to Delta)" card instead of
              sf_Internal_Notes__c (internal notes moved to node 21 only, see below);
              (c) defaults the 7 damage-type checkbox fields to "No" when blank on any
              non-suspicion session. Consumed by BOTH the accident/damage branch (18)
              and the reasonable-suspicion branch (7/8/9/4). -> 20
- 34 Data     Read SF Event -- Connected Object salesforce__get_event_request (Salesforce
              GET ES_Event_Request__c where Id = ${sf_Id}). PLACEHOLDER: data_connected_objects
              is empty until the CO is created and attached in the editor. -> 35
- 35 Script   Stage Salesforce-only Event Fields -- grades the read (2xx + records[0]); stages
              call_date, call_time, incident_date, incident_time, reason_for_test,
              specimens_requested, collection_time, company_name, collector_*_sf;
              transforms.sf_event_details_html (summary read-out / failure warning). -> 20
              SF API names read (confirmed 2026-10-23 via UI API object-info on the Quest UAT
              sandbox): Call_Date__c, Call_Time_Actual__c, Date_of_Incident__c,
              Time_of_Incident_Actual__c, Event_Reason2__c (label "Event Reason"),
              Type_of_Specimen_Requested__c, Appt_Scheduled_Time_Actual__c (label "Time of
              Collection"), Test_Type__c, Collector_Name__c, Collector_Phone__c, Collector_ETA__c
              (Double), GID_Number__c, Company__r.Name. The CO's
              SELECT list must include each one.
- 20 Content  Summary (renders ${transforms.sf_event_details_html} +
              ${transforms.final_print_summary_html}; captures email_address and optional
              collector_name/phone/eta/global_id_entry overrides). Button -> 36.
- 36 Script   Stage Email Content -- collector_* = agent entry || SF value; renders
              transforms.questionnaire_html (every answered question: node 1, donor role, node
              10, suspicion Q + signs, What Happened, and per-damage-type answers from
              transforms.final_records). -> 21 THE ONLY result/summary screen an agent sees (CR-001 R14 --
              old node 15's separate "Assessment Result" screen is gone). 
- 21 Email    Incident Summary (Delta ${event_type_label} Summary) (email_send_now="1") -> 22
- 22 Email    Event Information to collector, subject "Thank You for Covering - ${event_type_label}
              - ${sf_Airport_Code__c}" -- no donor PII; email_body contains a literal link to the Post Collection
              Flow tree (https://zingtree.com/live/173598167?zv_sf_Id=${sf_Id}#910); this is
              plain text inside the HTML body, not a Zingtree cross-tree node reference, so
              it needs no remapping when this tree is renumbered. -> 23
- 23 Content  Session Complete (terminal screen; was "New Node", CR-001 R19 retitle)
- 24 Content  claude.md (this node, unlinked -- no inbound edges, excluded from the flow)

## Determination sources (single-source-of-truth notes)
- Accident/damage/no-testing family: node 18 is the classification producer for the
  accident branch (DOT-trigger / deferred / no-testing / damage-qualifying). It feeds
  node 19 (the shared engine) via testing_classification/testing_summary_html.
- The no-testing path (10 -> 11 -> 12) does NOT run node 18 or any other producer --
  this is a PRE-EXISTING gap carried forward unchanged from the source baseline (node 12
  goes straight to node 19, same as old node 9 -> old node 32). Node 19's testing_summary_html
  fallback ("Testing Summary Unavailable") is what actually renders on this path today.
  Discovered during this build, confirmed out of scope for CR-001 (R3/R4 are explicitly
  unaffected) -- NOT fixed here. Flagged for a future CR if Brent wants a real "No Testing
  Required" determination card on this specific path (the abandoned v4 WIP branch's node 4
  attempted this fix but was not adopted into this build).
- FIXED 2026-08-27 (CR-004): until this date, node 19's fallback ("Testing Summary
  Unavailable -- the testing determination script did not run or produced no output")
  fired on EVERY session on BOTH branches, not just the no-testing path above -- including
  normal suspicion/accident sessions where node 7 or node 18 ran correctly. Root cause: the
  2026-07-29 same-day lint fix (see changelog) correctly moved testing_summary_html/_text
  to setTransformData-only per house rule, but node 19's read side was left as
  g('testing_summary_html') = ZT.getVariableValue(...), which only reads the FORM-DATA
  namespace -- it can never see a transforms-namespace value, so it always returned '' and
  always rendered the fallback, regardless of whether the producer ran. Fixed by reading
  transforms.testing_summary_html / transforms.testing_summary_text directly in node 19.
  Node 7 and node 18 were also updated to emit testing_summary_text (previously HTML-only
  on both), so the text-side fallback doesn't independently keep firing after this fix.
  The no-testing-path gap documented directly above is unrelated and still NOT fixed --
  10->11->12 still never calls a producer at all, by design, per that note.
- Reasonable-suspicion no-signs outcome (2026-09-24): node 7 sets RS_NO_TESTING; node 8
  skips the hotline alerts; node 19 shows a "No Testing Needed" card instead of "Action
  Required" (callRequired = hotlineRequired && !isNoTestingSuspicion). Account number /
  authority are still computed from role -- only the call/testing instruction changes.
- Reasonable-suspicion family: node 7 is the producer (deliberately separate per the
  2026-06-24 Quest decision -- RS is its own question set, same tree).
- Node 19 is the ONLY place either producer's output is consumed into a final payload --
  no more duplicated tail logic (old nodes 32 and 51 are gone).

## Data dictionary (key vars)
- Inbound query params: sf_Event_Type (Suspicion triggers RS), sf_Id, sf_Contact_Name__c,
  sf_Contact_Phone__c, sf_Department_Number__c, email (all read via merge fields in the two
  email bodies, not by any script).
- Node 1 radios (unchanged): sf_Specimen_Requested__c (major accident -- name/label
  mismatch is a pre-existing SFDC field-mapping quirk, out of scope), sf_Is_the_aircraft_destroyed__c,
  sf_Are_there_any_fatalities__c.
- Node 2 (NEW, upstream capture): employee_role, sf_Airport_Code__c, sf_Member_ID_Number__c,
  sf_Internal_Notes__c. Each captured EXACTLY ONCE tree-wide as of this build.
- sf_Are_there_any_Signs_or_Symptoms__c (PREDEFINED, 2026-09-24): node 6 Yes/No radio,
  was drugs_alcohol_suspicion. SF API name from Chris (Quest), 2026-09-24 email -- these
  feed Quest's Reasonable Suspicion Questionnaire & Checklist email template.
- sf_Signs_Symptoms__c (PREDEFINED, 2026-09-24): node 27 repeatable select (was
  suspicion_reason, single select on node 6). The form writes sf_Signs_Symptoms__c_1..n;
  node 7 is the ONE write of the joined value ("a;b;c", SF multi-select format, repeats
  dropped, "" when the answer is No). Option text cleaned to ASCII: trailing ";" removed
  from two options and the Word bullet glyph removed from "Other Explain in Notes".
  UNVERIFIED: field type (multi-select picklist vs text) and exact picklist values --
  confirm in Salesforce once sandbox access is restored.
- event_type_label (form, 2026-09-24): node 19, "Reasonable Suspicion" when
  isSuspicionCase else "Post Accident". Read by both email subjects and headers.
- sf_Additional_Notes__c on the suspicion path: bound directly on node 6 (visited once,
  same pattern as node 12). Accident path unchanged (node 18 aggregate write).
- Removed from node 19 (2026-09-24): sf_Suspicion_Reason__c and sf_Drug_Alcohol_Suspected__c
  writes -- not predefined (never reached SF), replaced by the two fields above.
- is_manual_dot: hidden field, set "true" on node 4 (immediate-DOT shortcut); folded into
  node 19's isDotAccident calc; forces isDot=true regardless of role/accident answers
  (CR-001 R15 preserved).
- No-testing factors (node 10): sf_Minor_or_cosmetic_damage__c,
  sf_Fault_due_to_mechanical_equipment_fail__c, sf_Incident_caused_by_weather__c (carries a
  pre-existing stub empty conditional config -- {"conditional":{"simple":[{"variable":"","op":"","value":""}]}}
  -- harmless no-op, predates this build, NOT fixed here per the v4-reconciliation
  instruction: only the claude.md node was carried forward from the abandoned v4 WIP
  branch, not its undocumented fixes), sf_Over_32_hours_since_incident__c (drives the
  No-Testing determination), hours_elapsed (conditional on >32h=="No"; feeds node 18's
  drug-only 8-32h window -- CR-001 R15 PRESERVED, NOT removed as the v4 WIP branch did).
- transforms.final_records: array of per-damage-type records (built at node 16).
- testing_classification / testing_summary_html / testing_summary_text: set by whichever

## IMPORT NOTE
A standalone importable Zingtree project JSON is the PROJECT OBJECT ITSELF at the top level (same keys as this dict: id, name, nodes, predefined_vars, script_code, etc.) -- NOT wrapped in {"projects":[...]}, and never combined with another project (e.g. the Post Collection Flow tree) in the same file. Both the grouped/multi-project export shape AND a single-project-wrapped-in-"projects" shape failed to import; confirmed 2026-09-03 against a known-good standalone export Brent provided as a reference.
